privacySections.title: Information used for a visit
privacySections.text: DocNow asks for your contact information, date of birth, identification details and reason for the visit. An unfinished intake form stays in the current page session. When you confirm an unpaid booking, DocNow saves your booking details and consent with your patient account.

privacySections.title: Access and services
privacySections.text: You can see your visits and approved summaries in your account. Assigned, verified doctors can access records for care. Administrators have access for authorised operations. DocNow uses Supabase for accounts and records and Daily for video visits. Doctors write and approve visit summaries.

privacySections.title: Details awaiting confirmation
privacySections.text: Before publication, the operator must confirm its legal name, privacy contact, retention periods, service locations and the process for requesting access or corrections.

termsSections.title: Using DocNow
termsSections.text: Use contact details you can access, enter accurate information and review the consent prompts before booking. The form checks the format of identification details. It does not authenticate an identity document.

termsSections.title: Video visits and booking
termsSections.text: A booking requests a video visit and depends on doctor availability. The listed consultation fee is AED 249. The current booking flow collects AED 0 at checkout. For a medical emergency in the UAE, call 998.

termsSections.title: Details awaiting confirmation
termsSections.text: Before publication, the operator must confirm the responsible clinic, licensing details, support and complaints contact, and billing and cancellation terms.
